summary.content:
Today's selection covers 64 articles from 8 trusted sources, including 38 on Artificial Intelligence and 13 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: I let Gemini in Google Maps plan my day and it went surprisingly well
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: Traffic violation scams switch to QR codes in new phishing texts
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BleepingComputer, The Verge, TechCrunch, NY Times Tech, Dark Reading and others
• **Fresh Content**: 12 articles published in the last 24 hours
